name: nexteno
description: Turn recorded meetings, from a Plaud.ai recorder or an audio file, into text inside the repository you are working in. The nexteno connector finds a meeting by what was said in it, transcribes it and names the speakers it recognises; the skill files the transcript where the repository's own .nexteno.json says, so the same plugin serves a knowledge base and a client project without knowing either.

com.nexaedge.marketplace.tagline: Bring recorded meetings and their transcripts into a repository
prompts: Bring in the transcript from today's call
Process the meeting I just recorded
